calls.statement:
SELECT member_id, member_key, join_date, tier, home_store_id, marketing_consent, valid_from, valid_to, is_current
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03'
ORDER BY member_id, valid_from

WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, valid_from,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS vn,
         COUNT(DISTINCT join_date) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id) AS n_join_dates
  FROM dim_member)
SELECT 'join_date=3Oct' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS rows_, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, MAX(n_join_dates) AS max_dates, SUM(CASE WHEN home_store_id=999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s999 FROM fv WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'first_version_valid_from=3Oct', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT member_id), MAX(n_join_dates), 0 FROM fv WHERE vn=1 AND valid_from = DATE '2026-10-03'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'neighbours 2Oct', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT member_id), 0, 0 FROM fv WHERE vn=1 AND join_date = DATE '2026-10-02'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'neighbours 4Oct', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT member_id), 0, 0 FROM fv WHERE vn=1 AND join_date = DATE '2026-10-04'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'neighbours 5Oct', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT member_id), 0, 0 FROM fv WHERE vn=1 AND join_date = DATE '2026-10-05'

WITH d AS (
  SELECT join_date, dayname(join_date) AS dow, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS n
  FROM dim_member WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-14' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1,2),
s AS (
  SELECT join_date, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS n_stg,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member) THEN member_id END) AS n_stg_not_in_dim
  FROM stg_member_updates WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-14' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT d.join_date, d.dow, d.n, s.n_stg, s.n_stg_not_in_dim FROM d LEFT JOIN s USING (join_date) ORDER BY 1
